subcategory: India's Widest Horseshoe Waterfall on the Indravati River
description: Known as the 'Niagara of India', an astounding 300-meter (980 ft) wide horseshoe waterfall where the Indravati River plunges 29 meters off the Vindhya plateau through dense tribal forest gorges.
why_visit: Stand before the widest natural waterfall in India; witness massive roaring muddy-red torrents during monsoons, take coracle boat rides right up to the spray pool in winter, and enjoy night illumination.
best_time_to_visit: July to October for monsoon roar; November to February for calm emerald waters
activities: Waterfall Viewing; Coracle Boat Rides; Canyon Photography; Tribal Handicrafts Shopping; Night Illumination Viewing
notes: Special spotlights illuminate the waterfall on weekend evenings; excellent Bastar Bell Metal (Dhokra) art sold nearby.
